processing.selection: Pacific Community members, plus Norfolk Island, the US minor outlying islands and two overlapping claims (Wake, Matthew and Hunter). Joint-regime areas, Hawaii, Easter Island and Asia-Pacific rim states are not included.
processing.dateline: Zones crossing +-180 are merged into one polygon with longitudes past 180.
